semantic_findings.topic: Disjoint child relocation and terminal substitution
semantic_findings.conclusion: No defect identified in the reviewed static composition. The four additive Fin-label embeddings are injective within pairwise disjoint ranges; all non-halt instructions, including branch destinations, calls and continuation labels, are relocated by the published ReferenceProgramLabels.instruction. callable replaces child halt slots with ret r3. Successful child traces cannot execute a halt, and child_return separately proves the mapped terminal is the required return, so terminal substitution does not silently change successful child-body steps.
semantic_findings.boundary: This is trace preservation for the proved, represented-input paths. It does not assert equivalence on arbitrary malformed machine states or make arbitrary child halt sites successful.

semantic_findings.topic: Original roots, caller stack, same heap and source
semantic_findings.conclusion: prepare_dispatch obtains vertex labels by executing RowVertices, creates the two-cell literal dispatch context, and aliases the original demand list through demand_table. Child calls save and restore caller registers, changing only d on return. The continuation temporarily saves (original demand root, dispatcher output root) in one appended pair, then restores c before the minimum/grid path. compute preserves arbitrary caller stack and source; solve_bit specializes to an initially empty stack and proves final empty stack, unchanged source, unchanged erased a/b/c addresses, retained cost/matrix/demand representations, append-only erased heap and dense final next.
semantic_findings.boundary: The root-equality conclusion is equality of erased/natural addresses, not an independently stated bit-string equality for each saved register. The high-level trace is existential but consists of literal tickNatural joins; the physical witness is obtained by the existing same-run simulation.

semantic_findings.conclusion: OriginalDispatch.Result uses flag false for infeasible, flag true for zero and nil for positive. Controller PC13303 sends both flags to the five-instruction early return, preserving the exact returned tagged root; nil restores c and invokes the optional minimum. OriginalRowMinimum.result_original identifies the optional minimum with BinaryFractionalDispatch.minimumPositive. Its nil result returns invalid; its pair result invokes GridFamilyInput on the original a/b/c roots. GridFamilyInput.values_original establishes the exact ordered state projection of guesses. continue_return targets run at computed inputWidth; compute uses solveInput_value/solveSizedInput to link to solveInput(...).1. No branch result or child output is a supplied premise of compute.
semantic_findings.boundary: The high-level result value .1 is linked. Equality of the physical charge to the high-level operation counter .2 is not asserted.

semantic_findings.topic: Covers output is ordered STATE PROJECTION only
semantic_findings.conclusion: Output.covers is a tagged heap pair whose payload satisfies GridFamily.StateList for results.map (fun r => some r.state). StateList is inductive list representation, so order, multiplicity and complete list length are retained; no sorting or dropping is used. BinaryFractionalCore.Result also contains operations and stopTests, neither encoded by this predicate. The same projected state list may represent distinct richer Result records with different counters. This is intentional and explicitly documented, not an encoding of full high-level records.
semantic_findings.boundary: No additional claim that the output serializes a complete Result, certificate, external wire format, or paper-level final answer follows solely from this predicate.

semantic_findings.topic: Extra minimum and controller instruction charging
semantic_findings.conclusion: Every lifted child_return pays k+1, including its appended ret. dispatchSteps already equals OriginalDispatch.steps+1 for the child core; dispatch_call then pays dispatchSteps+1 for the additional return. Prefix uses kv+(dispatchSteps+1)+6 <= rowBound+dispatchSteps+8. Positive-none uses km+3; positive-some uses km+kg+6 <= minimumBound+gridBound+8. Positive continuation adds four actual instructions; early return has five. The stated continuation bound adds13, and compute adds its two outer calls. Thus stated component bounds sum to rowBound+dispatchSteps+minimumBound+gridBound+23, safely inside advertised +32. inputBound separately includes the extra OriginalRowMinimum scan and replaces the grid recursive bound with GridFamilyEnvelope.instructionBound. solve_bit charges the same physical run plus its final stopped attempt via completeBound and monotonicity.
semantic_findings.boundary: The +32 is conservative. This review does not turn inputBound/completeBound into a newly proved closed polynomial purely in external serialized-input length; the separate envelope work and H/B premises retain their own scope.
